First, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and did they start suddenly or gradually?

message.content: I’m not sure exactly how long this has been going on, but it has been getting worse gradually. I have been feeling very nauseous, but I don't remember if I have actually vomited or what it looked like if I did. I also don't really know about my bowel movements or if I've been able to pass gas; I just know my stomach feels very bloated and painful.
